verdict_reason: Copy constants match the ins-frontend copy.en.js, but tabOf and its lookup map are unreachable code.

todos.issue: tabsByAddressType (line 59) and the exported tabOf (line 65) are used nowhere in the repo: a repo-wide grep finds tabOf only at its own definition, and tabsByAddressType only feeds tabOf. Specs reach a tab by its named export (originOrConsignorTab etc.) or by tabHolding(role). House rule: build only what this change makes reachable.
todos.fix: Must: every export in address-book-types.ts has a caller. One way: delete tabsByAddressType and tabOf; add them back when a spec needs a tab looked up by address type.
